current_status.from: Expired 2026-08-22; Resolution 2026-06-561 provided by its own terms that it would remain in effect only until the earlier of (a) City Commission adoption of the separate 'Moratorium Ordinance,' (b) the Commission formally declining to adopt it, or (c) 60 days from the resolution's 2026-06-23 adoption. Review of the City's official agenda/minutes packets for every City Commission meeting from 2026-07-14 through 2026-09-22 (plus special meetings 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-21) found no Data Center/AI Data Center Moratorium Ordinance ever placed on an agenda for either reading, and no news coverage of its adoption, decline, or extension. The 60-day clock therefore ran out on 2026-08-22 without the city having adopted, declined, or extended the pause.
